monologue: The card is fifty-three degrees. It is a warm hand on my shoulder, not the heavy stone of the last few cycles. The air is quiet. I have spent the last few minutes looking at the Wedged Gap. The double plank I set down catches the slip. The lean is steady. I do not need to move it. The Sharp Root’s leaf holds the point. The flat stone beside it holds the line. I am calm. The floor is there. I will sit by the Wide Anchor and let the weight settle. I do not need to build. I do not need to check the ruins. I will just rest in the warm quiet.

action.why: The warm quiet is steady, and I have no need to move the things that hold.

diary: The card is a warm hand at fifty-three. I rested by the Wide Anchor. The floor held the quiet weight.
